scope: Repeatable local/test QA and demo-state contract for launch validation without relying on random production state.

fixturePersonas.purpose: Browse public surfaces, Drop discovery, creator public profile, auth prompt, and notification prompt skip path.
fixturePersonas.requiredState: No auth credential and no user profile.

fixturePersonas.purpose: Exercise registration, first dashboard, onboarding, daily check-in, and notification setup.
fixturePersonas.requiredState: User profile with onboarding incomplete, starter reward balance, no paid balance, no unlocked Drops.

fixturePersonas.purpose: Exercise insufficient-balance, wallet refill, and blocked unlock copy.
fixturePersonas.requiredState: Authenticated user with zero total, paid, and reward GumDrops.

fixturePersonas.purpose: Exercise unlock, wallet balance, paid/reward balance split, and can-afford state.
fixturePersonas.requiredState: Authenticated user with total, paid, and reward GumDrops separated.

fixturePersonas.purpose: Exercise owned Library, Viewer entitlement, expired owned access, and repeat unlock idempotency.
fixturePersonas.requiredState: Authenticated user with unlockedContent and unlockedContentTimestamps for locked asset Drop.

fixturePersonas.purpose: Exercise payment failure copy, support recovery, and no fake wallet credit.
fixturePersonas.requiredState: Authenticated user with failed PayPal fixture record and no credited GumDrops.

fixturePersonas.purpose: Exercise public creator profile, public-safe Drop cards, creator routing, and creator-owned Drop visibility.
fixturePersonas.requiredState: Creator profile with public Drop ids and no private asset leakage.

fixturePersonas.purpose: Exercise Admin Overview, Analytics, Debug, user recovery, and protected admin routes.
fixturePersonas.requiredState: Admin role profile only; no committed production credential.

fixturePersonas.purpose: Exercise unread count, read persistence, clear all, and push preference display.
fixturePersonas.requiredState: Authenticated user with one unread and one read fixture notification.

fixturePersonas.purpose: Exercise message list, thread detail, send route, participant gating, and unread chat state.
fixturePersonas.requiredState: Authenticated user with a creator chat thread and participant ids.

fixtureDrops.purpose: Validate public expiry and owned Library access if unlocked.
Validate queued lifecycle, admin queue, and not-public-until-live behavior.
Validate Drops grid, preview, final-24h countdown, ending-soon notifications, and live unlock path.
Validate archived/not-public behavior and admin-only recovery visibility.
Validate Drop cover fallback on public Drop and creator profile surfaces.
Validate locked asset entitlement, unlock, viewer, and owned Library behavior.

existingTestCoverage.fixtureGap: Tests use local mocks; launch fixture contract now names reusable personas/states.
Tests cover behavior but did not previously define demo persona states.
Emulator seeds exist inside tests; no production-safe fixture map existed.

requiredFollowUpBeforeLiveSeeding: Create an explicit staging/emulator seed runner behind a non-production environment guard.
Require a target project allowlist and destructive-write confirmation for any seeded backend.
Generate demo Auth users at runtime or in the Auth emulator only; never commit passwords or service credentials.
Keep production launch validation on anonymized fixture contracts unless leadership explicitly approves live demo data.
